Being AI-literate in this critical sense means having the tools and strategies to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs using EDIA principles and being able to engage in equitable and inclusive prompting when required.
Advanced Critical AI Literacy explores how AI contributes to those inequalities and considers ways in which it could help redress power balances.
Critical AI Literacy applies the lens of equality, diversity, inclusion and accessibility (EDIA) to the use of AI.
